about_short_description.short_description: Formal is a SaaS technology startup that builds operating system for data of the modern company.

product.name: Formal Data Graph
product.description: A system that dynamically learns data flows, classifies data, and recommends and enforces least-privilege access policies in real time.

product.name: Formal Proxy (Protocol-aware Reverse-Proxy)
product.description: A reverse-proxy deployed in the customer’s VPC that monitors and controls data access to datastores and APIs without being in the data flow.

product.name: Data Security as Code
product.description: An API-first, code-driven approach to integrate Formal’s data security controls into infrastructure as code workflows using Terraform, Pulumi, TypeScript, and Python.

product.name: Dynamic Data Masking and Filtering
product.description: Techniques to dynamically mask or filter sensitive data in real time based on access policies to limit data exposure.

identifier.value: Access Control Features (RBAC/ABAC, MFA, Device Trust, Secret-less Auth)

product.name: Access Control Features (RBAC/ABAC, MFA, Device Trust, Secret-less Auth)
product.description: A suite of access control mechanisms including role-based and attribute-based access control, multi-factor authentication, device trust, and secret-less authentication.
